targets.query:
rangeDuration = uint(v: v.timeRangeStop) - uint(v: v.timeRangeStart)
rangeHours = float(v: rangeDuration) / 1000000000.0 / 3600.0
sBucket = if rangeHours > 168.0 then "eap_plh40_1d" else if rangeHours > 48.0 then "eap_plh40_1h" else "eap_plh40"
base = from(bucket: sBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air_quality") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id == "${NodeID}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp") |> group(columns: ["id"])
mi = base |> min() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Min" })) |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "gw", "host", "topic", "node"])
ma = base |> max() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Max" })) |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "gw", "host", "topic", "node"])
av = base |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Avg" })) |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "gw", "host", "topic", "node"])
cu = base |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Now" })) |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "gw", "host", "topic", "node"])
union(tables: [cu, av, ma, mi]) |> group()
